encoding.notes: bareFirstUseOrder = v3 without attributes, vertices renumbered by first use; bareRecastOrder = v3 without attributes in rcPolyMesh vertex order (the chosen form); withExplicitNeighbours = bareFirstUseOrder plus a stored neighbour per edge (the v2 approach); eighthYardVertices = bareFirstUseOrder with 1/8-yd XY and 1/4-yd Z vertices instead of voxel integers (the v2 quantisation); withZonesComp0 = bareFirstUseOrder plus the zone attribute stream and an all-zero component stream

seams.method: TS slab relinker (Detour findConnectingPolys/overlapSlabs rule: 0.01 yd along-side shrink, |dh| <= 2 x walkableClimb at either overlap end, or crossing). Block seams are tile sides on 4x4-ADT block boundaries; mid lines are tile sides at mod 16 = 8 (inside blocks, also ADT boundaries); byLineMod32 splits by boundary index mod 32.

queries.method: queries.ts, three runs on an otherwise idle machine; times are the median of the three (msRange = min and max): whole Kalimdor mesh (final pruned blocks); fixtures = dataset spawns of the zone sorted by (kind, id, x, y), every k-th to 300, endpoints rounded to 1 yd then snapped (rules A+B); one legsFrom per source over all 300 targets (90,000 directed legs); noPruning = the same without the component test; consecutive = 299 single-target legsFrom calls; ratio = (ground + swim) / straight for legs with straight > 50 yd (mesh-derived, not game truth); fetch = blocks holding a polygon settled by any search, with their gzip6 bytes; heapMB = the experiment process heap after loading (Float64 layout)

multiLevel.method: cities.ts: every dataset spawn of the zone; with = rules A (zone hint) + B, without = rule B only; ambiguous = containing candidates in more than one component after the rules; multiLayer = containing candidates more than 3 yd apart vertically. hintEffect (hintcheck.ts): where the snap without rule A lands (zone of the polygon, height difference to the hinted snap)

$comment: Steps 3b.3 and 3b.4 (tools/terrain/extract.ts, validate.ts; docs/research/terrain-navigation.md §17): the committed public/nav/ build, measured with the ported code.

Client wow_classic_beta 1.60.1.70009 (build key 05215079e3905ef5922ae0b03ffefb73) at WOW_INSTALL, read-only; recast-navigation 0.43.1 (WASM SHA-256 in public/nav/manifest.json); dataset QuestieDB b6f5b07 (dataRevision 65c377bc…). Sizes: gzip level 6 of each file on its own, decimal units.

Method: pnpm nav:extract --parts 12 (stage 1 in 12 worker processes, stage 2 in the parent), then pnpm nav:check --parts 12 (an independent full rebuild compared byte for byte; the timings below are from that run), then pnpm nav:validate --client --partition --parts 8. Timings are one run each on an otherwise idle machine (the machine block above); per-block and full input lists are in the gitignored generated/terrain-nav-report.json.

build.budget: full build ≤ 5 min wall on 8 cores (§14.3): 76.3 s with 12 processes

sizes.capAndTarget: D-030: 5,423,019 B against the 7,000,000 B cap (1,576,981 B headroom) and the 5-6 MB target; every block under the 300,000 B block cap

why: Vertices keep rcPolyMesh order (§5, the smaller of the measured orders); the prototype final blocks kept its stage-1 first-use renumbering. Re-encoding these final blocks with first-use order gives 5,677,066 B (+5.05%).
No component stream in the blocks (RC-03); the per-polygon zone attributes cost 0.31% (these blocks re-encoded with one zone per block: 5,387,533 B).
The corrected WMO liquid rule (3b.2, U14) keeps 168 more Kalimdor polygons after pruning (367,568 against 367,400).

census.method: Every dataset spawn with a world point on maps 0 and 1, snapped with rules A (zone hint = the area key rolled up through AreaTable ParentAreaID; for every spawn at this pin the roll-up equals the key, so the manifest hintRollup is empty) and B (20 polygons); off-main spawns grouped by component and anchor (§12).
againstPrototype: Kalimdor: main 31,649 (prototype 31,650), off-main 1,750 (1,748), none 11 (12); the corrected WMO liquid rule changes 3,230 triangles in 7 blocks (U14); no component joins or splits among the named ones.

Eastern Kingdoms: main 40,977 (40,944), off-main 196 (229), from the same 397,266 stage-1 polygons. Two prototype components (82 and 91 polygons with 18 and 14 spawns: npc 1653, 2551, 4505 and 1565, 1653, 2547) are now in main: 32 of the 33. Cause (INFERRED: the polygons are identical, so only linking differs): the derived adjacency now pairs edges on rcPolyMesh vertex numbering, which is Recast's own pairing (G5b 54,098 of 54,098), whereas the prototype paired them after its first-use renumbering, which can differ where more than two polygons meet at one edge.

firstReview.method: Entries whose note starts with 'reviewed:' were examined individually (Teldrassil and Darnassus, Rut'theran, Thunder Bluff, the Ban'ethil Barrow Den chamber of RC-02, the G7 floors, the three zones, the four water splits); the others were drafted by tools/terrain/review-draft.ts from measured facts with the rules in its header ('rule:' notes): geometric descriptions, not in-game checks.

gnarlpineHold.finding: RC-02's component 23 (here 98 polygons, 27 spawns: npc 2009, 2010, 2011, 7318 and object 106318) is the lower chamber of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den WMO: its polygons carry WMOAreaTable area 262 ('Ban\'ethil Barrow Den', AreaTable 1.60.1.70009, ParentAreaID 141), z 1254-1313, under the Teldrassil surface (z 1330-1450) near world (9800, 1560). Its closest approach to Teldrassil's dominant component is 18.8 yd (17.5 yd of it vertical); the nearest vertex pairs are at least 4.9 yd apart in 2D.
gnarlpineHold.cause: Rebuilding block 1:12_28 alone with radius 0, the chamber joins through a spiral ramp that climbs from z 1261 to 1336; on that ramp near (9857, 1571, 1328) WMO triangles of the den itself (tag 262, not M2 doodads) lie 1.1-2.9 yd above the floor, so with 2-yd clearance only a strip too narrow to survive the 0.52-yd erosion is left.

proposedBudgets.$comment: For the architect to record in tools/build/dist-requirements.json (not edited here): measured bytes of this build.

$comment: Step 3b.5 (src/nav, docs/research/terrain-navigation.md §9.5, §9.6, §14.3; RC-06, RC-07, RC-13): the runtime on the committed public/nav, measured by tests/bench/nav.bench.ts (node --expose-gc --import tsx tests/bench/nav.bench.ts --runs 3 --write).

Fixtures on map 1 (Kalimdor): durotar and barrens are the prototype sets of §9.5 (zone spawns sorted by kind, id, x, y; every k-th to 300; rounded to 1 yd; snapped with rules A and B). barrensPool is the realistic section (RC-07): every quest with zoneOrSort 17 (The Barrens), 98 quests and about 300 actions; its quest givers and turn-in targets (first spawn on the map) and one location per objective (the spawn nearest the centroid of the objective entities' Barrens spawns; items through their droppers), unique after 1-yd rounding.

matrixMs: one legsFrom per source over every target with the whole map resident (median of the runs, range given); buildReference: the same legs from the build's reference legsFrom (tools/terrain/lib/legs.ts, the code G10 and G10b check against Detour), compared field by field; consecutive: N - 1 single-target legs; ratio: (ground + swim) / straight line for legs longer than 50 yd straight (mesh-derived, not game truth); ratio3dOver2d: the 3D length through the portal crossings (each at its portal's interpolated height, endpoints by the polygon's fan triangle) over the 2D length, legs over 50 yd (RC-13); computingPathsFromEmpty: from an empty mesh, snap every endpoint (loading every block within 6 yd), then the matrix with the searches loading the blocks they reach (RC-06): decode and link included, fetch and SHA-256 not; blocks and gzip6 are the blocks loaded (the fetch baseline, §9.6).

memory: each continent resident in the typed layout: typedLayoutBytes (sum of the typed arrays the mesh holds) and searchScratch (the per-map Dijkstra arrays); heapGrowthMB = growth of heapUsed + arrayBuffers after gc (node --expose-gc) for opening and loading every block, file bytes read beforehand. blockDecodeAndLinkMs: each block decoded and added alone to an empty mesh.

proposedCeiling: the absolute ceiling for "computing paths" of the realistic section on the Milestone 9 throttled profile (4x CPU): computingPathsFromEmpty.ms x 4 x 1.25 (the 25% regression allowance), rounded up to 100 ms. Fetch and SHA-256 of the blocks come on top and are measured in 3b.6.

proposedCeiling.basis: computingPathsFromEmpty.ms of barrensPool x 4 x 1.25, rounded up to 100 ms; excludes fetch and SHA-256
